Method of Attack: Use of polyglot MSI/JAR and CAB/JAR files to evade detection by security tools
Combination of JAR and MSI or CAB formats into single files executed as MSI in Windows and as JAR by Java runtime
Hiding malicious code in JAR part to trick anti-virus scanning
Distribution via Sendgrid and URL shortening services like Cutt.ly and Rebrand.ly
Attack Vector: Polyglot files combining MSI/JAR or CAB/JAR formats
Email or URL-based delivery using Sendgrid and URL shorteners
Indicators of Compromise: Use of C2 address hosted by a Bulgarian hosting firm
